providerStatus: TinyFish search and fetch_content used to find and read sources. Exchange and company PDFs were downloaded and searched locally with pypdf.
method: Lesson-editor review of quick, helps and hurts claim by claim against each lesson's official sources, plus the newest dated filing for context; checker warnings fixed by rewriting.
scope: state-bank-of-india, milky-mist, maruti-suzuki, mahindra-and-mahindra, kanohar-electricals, dr-reddys. Plain-language and source check of pre-financial text; not a financial audit.
financialPolicy: No financial figures, snapshots or financial-review files changed. Dr. Reddy's financialNotes text reworded only to define IFRS and PSAI. Recent quarterly results are described in words and percentages only.
